label: Origin-deletion controls checked (inference)
rule: Explicit finite interpretations checked by case analysis
meaning: Model-witnessed neutrality of the four encoded origin-tolerance commitments on individual deletion: with all four holding, deletion fails at a successor of actual (faithful, which is also the countermodel to Arrival A) or at actual itself (restored), and holds at every world (withEmpty, which adds a world with no individuals). So the encoded commitments entail neither deletion nor its failure, at actual, at accessible worlds or at every world. withEmpty is a bare Ontic, not a History, so presence-to-existence, inert emptiness and the possible contingent-free past are not stated for it; any history structure on withEmpty must violate one of them at actual (by accessibleDeletionExcluded). Model claims concern these finite interpretations only; counterpart, vague or kind-relative tolerance readings are not tested.
